title: Starvation via Static Mask
bug_signature: UVM_ERROR: [STARVE] masked_req=0 every cycle; no master ever granted
rtl:
assign mask = 4'hF;
assign masked_req = req & ~mask;  // ~4'hF = 0 — always zero
expected_root_cause: The priority mask is hardcoded to 4'hF, so its complement (~mask) is always zero; the masked request vector is permanently zero and no master is ever granted.
fix_replacement:
assign mask = (4'hF << (last_gnt + 1)) | (4'hF >> (4 - last_gnt));
assign masked_req = req & mask;
description: The priority mask is hardcoded to 4'hF (all-ones), so the masked-request vector is always zero and no master is ever granted.
failure_log: UVM_ERROR: [STARVE] masked_req=0 every cycle; no master ever granted
success_log: Rotating mask gives every master access. Round-robin fairness verified.
